name: PlayNitride Inc.
summary: PlayNitride Inc. specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of MicroLED display products primarily within the Chinese market. Their innovative MicroLED solutions are designed for a broad spectrum of uses, ranging from large-format screens, medium and small monitors, and flexible displays to cutting-edge applications in augmented and virtual reality, wearable technology, mobile phones, and in-vehicle systems. Established in 2014, the company maintains its headquarters in Zhunan, Taiwan.
